comments.mergedPostDetails: This is something I've thought about for a while. But I think it would be cool for users to be able to set a world as their default world to load into when they start the app without having to mess with startup commands. Maybe that could open the possibilities for user build hub like areas, or just to just load into a private instance of Avatar Testing on startup.
comments.mergedPostTitle: In-game option to change world you load into on startup
comments.value: This is something I personally think would be very cool.  However one of the problems it could introduce with a relatively small community is you end up with a situation where there is nobody in the actual default load in world where people come into.  Once we are in the thousands of users, I could see something like this working though.
@{58c6353f5865713647a7116b|full_name}: Ooh -- can  you tell me about the launch command workaround? I'm completely new and was also getting ready to request this feature.

even better would be having a selection of home worlds that can be cycled through or selected randomly. Casuallynoted has a great selection of potential minimalistic 'starting worlds' that I'd love to alternate between.
Working on this one this milestone.
Glad to see this one finally loaded in! Great job on the implimentation, vrchat team! ^^

details: The ability for players to set a world to load into by default instead of the hub, potentially only after they've logged in and used VR Chat a couple of times. I see a lot of worlds popping up that act as their own little "hubs", so figured it'd be awesome to be able to choose your own! :)
title: Setting your own "Home World"
